title: Movement adjudicator and DATC qualification
summary: Native ooRexx authoritative movement API; 32 original and 130 DATC-derived movement positions, deterministic reversed-insertion replay.
invariants: Units keyed by province; submitted keyed by power with arrays of original lines. Inputs remain unchanged.
Result exposes units, dislodged tuple (original unit, attacker origin, convoy flag), outcomes, standoffs, paradoxes and published power/original/status records.
Rules loaded from data/rules.conf; no player legal-order interface.
Explicit VIA CONVOY for adjacent convoy intent; Szykman backup; distinct physically impossible convoy versus missing matching orders.
Recursive decision trials check final equations except explicit paradox overrides; bounded 4096 trials fail closed.

Original trial-based adaptation; Claude reviewed dev4 and reported no failures in 98000 random/mutated positions, no trial cap exhaustion. F2 strict support-coast option explicitly authorised by Tom on 2026-11-26.
A future caller must trap unresolved syntax 93.900, log failure and stop rather than publish a board.
SUPPORT_COAST=STRICT is enforced by the config validator. An incorrect explicit supported-unit origin coast yields INVALID:BAD_SUPPORT; omit coast where otherwise allowed.
Fresh dev4r2 mutation audit (not a unique-random-board oracle): 10000 mixed + 10000 convoy-fixture mutations, zero invariant failures, 1419 paradox cases; see diplomacy.qualification.

evidence.scope: 130 v3.0 positions, 32 original, plus 6 v3.4 review positions and 2 strict-policy regressions B.16/B.17. DATC-preferred expectations preserved for reference; intentional 4.B.5 deviation. F.28/F.29 not available locally.
